**What problem are you trying to solve?**

Describe the real workflow this would unblock, not just the feature itself.

**Proposed solution**

What you think Tapwright should do. Rough is fine — this is a starting
point for discussion, not a spec.

**Check first**

Please skim [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md) and
[ARCHITECTURE.md](../../ARCHITECTURE.md) — some things (restbus GUI
authoring, calibration/XCP write, hard-real-time HIL) are deliberately out
of scope, and it saves everyone time to know that before discussing a
design.

**Alternatives considered**

Any other way you've worked around this so far.
